title: crepidium polyodon
intro: Crepidium polyodon, commonly known as the 'Tiger Orchid', is a species of orchid. This plant is known for its unique features and medicinal properties. Crepidium polyodon is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
